name: BepInEx 5
hint_note: For Unity MONO games (managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll next to the exe). NOT for IL2CPP games (GameAssembly.dll) — those need BepInEx 6 IL2CPP or MelonLoader.
notes: Round 79: browse_url is opened in the signed-in browser (never fetched by the plugin); the ZIP the user downloads is extracted by install_loader ONLY for descriptors whose capabilities.loader_install is true (user-configured games), journaled per file with backup+rollback. Steam launch options are NEVER edited by the plugin — if the game needs WINEDLLOVERRIDES the panel shows the text and the user pastes it in Steam themselves.
